name: size_bearing_bias
description: A constant error in the perceived target width, passed to the range as a camera that ranges from an assumed size does (range_coupling: width, range scaled by the width factor). Where on the TASC car-car cases does it start to crash, and is reading too far (width factor > 1) worse than too near? No randomness, one run per case and level. With sigma 0 this equals the size plugin at the same scale (tested), so it is the size law on the TASC cases. Sensitivity levels, not sensor values. 686 runs.
